_about: Archival background images. Every entry is public domain or CC0 on Wikimedia Commons; `page` is the source record. Processed renditions in public/img/archive/ are produced by build-archive-images.js (originals are downloaded to .cache/, not committed). `crop.box` is the picture area as [left, top, right, bottom] fractions; `crop.focus` is the vertical centre of wide crops (0 top, 1 bottom). `credit` is the line printed on the page.
